The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1f0bf283be86c80b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let the phase data above be fixed. Let P1, . . . , Pd be fixed smooth tensor-valued differential operators polynomial above order two, and put P(G) = γ(G) + d X i=1 ϵi Pi(G), 0 ≤ ϵ ≤ 1. There is a finite exponent p, depending on these operators and independent of the integer q below, with the following property. Suppose G is an immersion whose 2-jets satisfy the stated compact margins, H ∈ U0, and j2 G = Os(1), H = Os(1). For every positive integer q, every δ > 0, and scales 0 < τ ≤ s ≤ 1, define η = τ s + ϵτ−p . If η and δ/τ are sufficiently small, there is a smooth displacement U such that U = Oτ (δτ), P(G + U) − P(G) − δ2 H = Oτ δηq + δ3 τ ! . (4.4) The smallness thresholds and every fixed output norm use only finitely many weighted input bounds. Their required orders may increase with q. Each local summand of U is supported in an original phase support or an intersection of two such supports. If the perturbation sum is absent, take η = τ/s.
